Choose how Elektro-Engel should explain things and whether simple feedback may be counted locally.

People have feelings—technology should support people, not decide for them. Elektro-Engel defaults to brief replies, asks when unsure, and takes extra care with important topics. Feedback never changes answers automatically.
YOUR DATA STAYS ON THIS DEVICE

This preview stores your explanation-style choice and—only after you opt in—aggregate feedback counts. A session summary stores only what you deliberately enter. Conversation transcripts, timestamps, and device identifiers are not stored or transmitted. Everything stays on this device until you delete it or uninstall the app. The counters do not train a model or change answers.
